reddit.title: New Materials Interface for Building in Provincia
reddit.body: We've revamped how you manage resources when building in Provincia! Instead of a single cost chip, each build tile now displays a detailed Materials sheet, showing you what's stored and what's required for construction. This makes it easier to see what you need at a glance and plan your builds effectively. Check out the full details here: https://provincia.ch/devtalk/materials-instead-of-cost-badges?utm_source=reddit&utm_medium=social&utm_campaign=materials-instead-of-cost-badges

steam.title: Materials Management Revamp in Provincia
steam.body: We're excited to announce a significant update to how materials are displayed in Provincia! Each build tile now features a dedicated Materials sheet that shows you everything you need for construction. This enhancement allows for better resource management and planning. Discover more about this update and how it improves your building experience: https://provincia.ch/devtalk/materials-instead-of-cost-badges?utm_source=steam&utm_medium=social&utm_campaign=materials-instead-of-cost-badges
